$comment: MCPB v0.2 manifest for @muhaven/mcp. Per ADR-3 the JWT is acquired via the device-code ceremony and stored in the broker's keystore — it is NOT a user_config entry. Sensitive items declared here are limited to the broker session-key + IPC endpoint overrides.
name: muhaven-mcp
description: Confidential RWA portfolio management on Fhenix CoFHE. Read your encrypted balances, propose yield claims and policy changes — all signing happens in a sibling broker daemon, the LLM never sees your private key.
long_description: MuHaven MCP exposes 22 tools across read.* / position.* / policy.* / issuer.* / governance.* groups for managing real-world asset (RWA) tokens with FHE-encrypted balances. Authentication uses a one-time device-code ceremony (run `muhaven-broker login`); subsequent tool calls fetch the JWT from the broker over a Unix socket. Position / governance tools return unsigned UserOps + broker signatures — they NEVER auto-submit to a bundler. The companion `muhaven-broker` daemon must be running before tools can be invoked. See README for setup.

tools.name: muhaven.read.portfolio
tools.description: Encrypted-balance portfolio summary; aggregates only.

tools.name: muhaven.read.yields
tools.description: Per-token yield history (cleartext aggregates).

tools.name: muhaven.read.distribution
tools.description: Distribution status for a (token, epoch).

tools.name: muhaven.read.tokens
tools.description: RWA tokens the user holds.

tools.name: muhaven.read.audit
tools.description: User's tiered-autonomy audit log.

tools.name: muhaven.position.buy
tools.description: Propose a Subscription buy. Returns unsigned UserOp.

tools.name: muhaven.position.sell
tools.description: Propose a redemption-queue sell. Returns unsigned UserOp.

tools.name: muhaven.position.claim
tools.description: Propose a yield claim. Returns unsigned UserOp.

tools.name: muhaven.position.rebalance
tools.description: Propose a multi-leg atomic rebalance.

tools.name: muhaven.policy.set_tier
tools.description: Request / commit a tiered-autonomy transition.

tools.name: muhaven.policy.pause
tools.description: Activate /pause kill-switch.

tools.name: muhaven.policy.audit_export
tools.description: Drain the audit log to JSON.

tools.name: muhaven.policy.session_key_status
tools.description: Inspect ZeroDev session-key state.

tools.name: muhaven.issuer.distribute_yield
tools.description: Propose a yield distribution. Issuer-only.

tools.name: muhaven.issuer.kyc_add
tools.description: Propose adding an investor to the ERC-3643 whitelist. Issuer-only.

tools.name: muhaven.issuer.kyc_remove
tools.description: Propose removing an investor from the ERC-3643 whitelist. Issuer-only.

tools.name: muhaven.issuer.unpause_token
tools.description: Propose set-NAV-and-unpause for a freshly-deployed token. Issuer-only.

tools.name: muhaven.issuer.audit_query
tools.description: Read your own tiered-autonomy audit log (issuer-self).

tools.name: muhaven.read.protection_coverage
tools.description: Read the on-chain DefaultProtection coverage state for a token (P11).

tools.name: muhaven.read.kyc_attestation
tools.description: Read the KYC attestation registry status for an investor (P11).

tools.name: muhaven.governance.propose
tools.description: Propose an EncryptedGovernance vote. Returns unsigned UserOp (P11).

tools.name: muhaven.governance.cast_vote
tools.description: Cast an encrypted vote on an open proposal. Returns unsigned UserOp (P11; runner deferred to Wave 5).

user_config.title: MuHaven backend URL
user_config.description: Backend host. Default: https://api.muhaven.app (production). Use https://api-stage.muhaven.app for staging.

user_config.title: MuHaven dashboard URL
user_config.description: Dashboard origin used by the device-code authorization page (/link). Default: https://muhaven.app. Hardcoded for phishing resistance — do not change unless you know what you are doing.

user_config.title: muhaven-broker IPC endpoint
user_config.description: Path to the broker's Unix socket (POSIX) or named pipe (Windows). Leave blank to use the per-user default.

user_config.title: Read-only mode
user_config.description: When enabled, only the muhaven.read.* toolset is exposed; position.* and policy.* tools are not registered.

$comment_setup: First-run instructions: (1) install this package via your MCPB host (Claude Desktop / Cursor / Claude Code) or globally via `npm install -g @muhaven/mcp`. (2) Run `muhaven-broker setup` — one-shot: applies env defaults, mints an ephemeral session key, spawns the broker daemon detached, then walks you through the passkey-bound device-code login (opens browser to https://muhaven.app/link?code=XXXX-XXXX). The daemon stays running after `setup` returns. Use `muhaven-broker setup --foreground` if systemd / launchd / a Windows service will own the daemon's lifecycle instead. (3) Use any tool in this MCP package.
